script.text: Dr. Crowler was still looking for someone that could defeat Jaden Yuki in a duel. He thought that he found his answer in Bastion Misawa, a mathematic genius who calculated his duels to an exact formula.
Later in class, a fellow Blue student told Chazz Princeton that he can no longer sit in the Obelisk Blue section. Chazz would now have to sit with the Ra Yellow losers instead.
This is all wrong! I don’t belong over there with those losers!
Dr. Crowler, tell everyone this is a mistake! Tell them I belong up here!
But you don’t. You haven’t since you lost that one duel to, oh, who was it now? Ah yes, I remember – Jaden Yuki.
Which is why you will duel Bastion Misawa tomorrow. And if you lose to him as well, you two will switch dorms!
You mean...I’d become a...Ra Yellow duelist?!
Yes, very good. Now if only you could duel as well as you listen!
The next morning, a school staff member told Jaden that there were a larger number of cards floating in the water off the docks. Jaden, Bastion, and Syrus went to investigate.
Ahh! That's Ring of Destruction!
And Vorse Raider!
Bastion, these are all of your cards!
It’s my own fault. This deck was in my desk, and I moved my desk to the hallway yesterday when we were painting. Someone must have taken it then.
Who would do something like this?!
Someone who doesn't want you to advance to Obelisk Blue, that's who.
Your deck is totally ruined! Aww man, what in the world are you gonna do now, Bastion?
Your promotion exam is in less then an hour!
Less than an hour later...
Bastion! You've made it...and I see you've bought some friends.
I hope you duel better than the company you keep.
Wait a sec...Chazz is your test opponent? Bastion, then he musta been the one who tossed your cards!
Pardon?!
I don’t know what he’s talking about, Dr. Crowler. I didn’t do a thing.
Oh, is that so? I saw you, Chazz. This morning by the water. You dumped them in and ran off.
I normally wouldn’t snitch, but you don’t mess with someone’s deck.
Aww come on! Who’s to say I wasn’t throwing away my own cards? I guess Bastion and I just had similar decks, that’s all.
Liar!
No one calls me a liar, and no one calls me a thief!
Fine, then you’re not. Let’s just have our duel.
